name: flag-docs-and-unseen-file
repoContext:
## AGENTS.md

# fetchq agent guide

## Rules for changes

- Every new command-line flag must be listed in `docs/cli.md`, with its default.
- Every environment variable the binary reads must be listed in `.env.example`.

## Tests

Flag parsing is covered by the tests in `tests/cli.rs`, which run the binary with `assert_cmd`.

findings.title: The new `--timeout` flag is not listed in `docs/cli.md`
findings.description: The PR adds the `--timeout` flag with a default of 30 and changes only `src/cli.rs` and `src/client.rs`. `AGENTS.md` requires every new flag to be listed in `docs/cli.md` with its default. Add the flag to `docs/cli.md`.
